name: repopulse-scan-tools
description: Node-based scan tools baked into the sandbox image (W9-02). jscpd is pinned to the 4.x line: 5.x ships platform-specific native binaries and has no linux/arm64 musl build, so it cannot run in an Alpine sandbox at all. The committed lockfile pins the whole tree, because a scanner whose transitive dependencies float at build time is a scanner whose findings are not reproducible. The commander override exists because jscpd 4.3.0 resolves commander 12+, which is ESM-only and cannot be require()d from jscpd's own CommonJS bundle — the tool crashes on --version without it.
